maintenance.reason: Alpha9.38 repairs Live ROI while deliberately preserving Alpha9.37's three-way customer comparison: Without KEMS remains the no-solar/no-battery counterfactual, Live remains the measured physical property, and KEMS remains the complete configured future system including battery and paid export. Actual payback, actual value and physical evidence remain strictly scoped from the selected Financial commissioning date; simulated battery/export gains never enter actual payback. The full-KEMS ROI projection now retains the longer property-learning observation window instead of discarding pre-commission evidence, so a useful projection can be published as soon as the retained evidence satisfies the established seven-day gate even when only a few physical operating days have elapsed. The ROI physical-evidence card now references the registered House electricity since commissioning entity and no longer renders Entity not found. Alpha9.38 is ROI/reporting only: no optimiser allocation, tariff policy, Agile dispatch, battery policy, SOC arithmetic, commissioning authority, control eligibility or FoxESS command/write authority changes. Pi Web remains 0.9.0-alpha9-web.0, Public Web remains 0.9.0-alpha9-public.0 and Panel remains 0.9.0-alpha9-panel.3; real FoxESS hardware writes remain hard-blocked until physical commissioning is complete.
